message:
Place five round-5 sub-exponential 3-SAT packets in SubexponentialSAT

File the fifth round of ETH refinement packets (arrival 26bd83d4b3) under
Computability/SubexponentialSAT/Research and retire their archives from
docs/incoming, which now holds only its README. All five reviewed the
round-4 placement, and several cite the anthropics/formal-math Lean
development. All improve only the cached (subexponential-space) branch,
except one low-degree schedule. Generic polynomial space stays at 46.185;
the SAT order n log log n/sqrt(log n) is unchanged.

Retired archives, where each went, and what each claims (cached
time/space, per normalized wire):
- sat_pairwise_certificates (32 files): 29.812/29.812, the smallest cached
  time; polynomial space 16.812 at degree <= s^(1/12) (from 23.666); two
  structural obstructions.
- sat_affine_contraction (30): 30.257/25.989, the smallest cached space.
- sat_affine_geometry (57): 30.270/29.488.
- sat_affine_cauchy (50): 30.413/29.466; guarded fast Cauchy transforms,
  with negative timings kept.
- sat_affine_plane (44): 30.691/29.466.

Each archive was extracted with `py -I` into its own empty scratch
directory and checked for unsafe paths. Not filed:
- one SHA256SUMS ledger;
- sat_affine_geometry's copy of this project's README at d86bd7259c
  (appended to OMITTED.tsv);
- seven generated build byproducts of sat_affine_geometry (report.aux,
  .fdb_latexmk, .fls, .log, .out, .toc and a __pycache__ .pyc), which the
  repository keeps out of history and which remain in the arrival archive.
Six delivered results/*.log build records are force-added, and three CRLF
CSV files are marked -text. As in round 4, no separate manifest, omission
or link recheck was run, and no supplied script or build was run.

The project README gains a round-5 table, and the cached ladder now ends
at 29.812 time / 25.989 space. The low-degree list leads with 16.812. The
docs/incoming table and the Computability index are updated.

Link the anthropics/formal-math Lean development of eth.pdf

The Claude-credited manuscript "A 2^{o(n)} time algorithm for 3-SAT"
(Research/claude-2o-n-3sat/eth.pdf) said its Lean development would be
linked "when a public location exists". It is now public in
https://github.com/anthropics/formal-math, added by pull request
anthropics/formal-math#31 (commit 1a6eee293b9e00cb432eef6018a21f523623a9af,
merged as 16a5ce4130 on 2026-10-27).

Computability/SubexponentialSAT/README.md:
- The eth.pdf row now points to the published development instead of
  calling it unpublished.
- A new section, "Lean development of eth.pdf", links the repository, the
  PR's changes at that commit (as Vladimir asked), the commit, and the eth/
  tree at it. It summarises the contents as the PR describes them:
  MainResults.lean, Solution.lean, comparator.json, and the two sorry in
  Challenge.lean only. At the merge commit eth/ holds 1,062 files, 1,052 of
  them .lean.
- The section notes that eth/paper.pdf (900,337 bytes) is a different
  revision from the 868,673-byte eth.pdf filed here.

Computability/README.md links the eth/ tree from the project's entry.

The development is linked, not vendored, and nothing here builds or checks
it.

Place nine round-4 sub-exponential 3-SAT packets in SubexponentialSAT

File the fourth round of ETH refinement packets (arrival b9941a7396) under
Computability/SubexponentialSAT/Research, and retire their archives from
docs/incoming, which now holds only its README. Seven packets reviewed the
round-3 placement; 3sat_round3_frontier and eth_adaptive_schedules reviewed
only through round 2. All keep the SAT order n log log n/sqrt(log n), and
their coefficients are per normalized wire.

Retired archives, where each went, and what each claims:
- sat_adaptive_bounds (30 files): polynomial-space C = 46.185, the new
  smallest (from 55.709); cached 34.325/34.024; low-degree cached
  13.380/13.253.
- sat_adaptive_tree_certificate (43): cached 30.891 time / 30.754 space, the
  new smallest cached pair, from per-allocation choice among three
  contraction trees.
- sat_adaptive_frontier (39): polynomial 50.305; cached 31.252/31.252.
- sat_adaptive_matrix_partition (35): polynomial 50.210; cached
  34.325/34.024, the same pair as sat_adaptive_bounds, found independently.
- subexponential_sat_adaptive_four (35): cached 32.916/31.662 (32.856/31.467
  with a 19/8 backend); polynomial 50.394.
- subsat_rectangular (40): polynomial 53.978; cached 33.994/33.994;
  precision barriers.
- eth_adaptive_exact_kernels, from ETH_Adaptive_Exact_Kernels_2026-10-27.zip
  (93): polynomial 55.332 (25.164 at degree <= s^0.51); cached
  35.071/34.000; measured kernel speedups 1.46-2.73x. 58 sources/ snapshots
  are omitted.
- 3sat_round3_frontier (89): polynomial 63.757 and 23.666 at degree
  <= s^(1/12), the new low-degree polynomial-space best; cached
  37.930/33.623 and low-degree 14.239/12.361. 26 evidence/ copies omitted.
- eth_adaptive_schedules (39): polynomial 63.781; cached 37.592/33.623;
  an incremental matching-potential kernel.

Each archive was extracted with `py -I` into its own empty scratch directory
and checked for unsafe paths. 85 members are not filed: one SHA256SUMS
ledger (.gitignore policy) and 84 byte-identical copies of files at ProveIt
73dfb5e5ab or upstream, appended to Research/OMITTED.tsv. Duplicated
.py/.sh files are kept. Five CRLF tables are marked -text, and seven
delivered .log files are force-added past *.log. At Vladimir's request, no
separate manifest, omission or link recheck was run for this round. No
supplied script, test or build was run.

The project README gains a round-4 table and updated ladders. Polynomial
space now runs 18,535.75 -> ... -> 46.185, about 401x on the upper bound,
and the cached best is 30.891/30.754. The low-degree and measured-speedup
lists are extended. The docs/incoming table and the Computability index are
updated.

Place five round-3 sub-exponential 3-SAT packets; restore two round-2 scripts

File the third round of ETH refinement packets under
Computability/SubexponentialSAT/Research and retire their archives from
docs/incoming. All five reviewed the fifteen earlier packets (ProveIt
474ddba696/6d3adc4506). They combine compatible ingredients and add the
corpus's first measured kernel speedups. All keep the SAT order
n log log n/sqrt(log n), and their coefficients are per normalized wire.

Retired archives, where each went, and what each claims:
- sat_adaptive_contraction_2026-10-26.zip (fa6e904d10):
  sat_adaptive_contraction/, 50 files. Polynomial-space C = 55.709, the new
  smallest (sqrt(17/24) x the composed 66.193). Cached 36.750/34.024;
  15.392/14.250 at degree <= s^(1/12). Modular Cauchy kernel 6.22-58.62x.
- sat_frontier_improvements_2026-10-26.zip (f898a9fde4):
  sat_frontier_improvements/, 37 files. Polynomial-space 63.857; 26.902 at
  degree <= s^(1/12) and 31.929 at s^(3/5); cached 38.484/34.275; quadratic
  Cauchy table construction.
- subexponential_sat_frontier_2026-10-26.zip (f42479bca2):
  subexponential_sat_frontier/, 48 files. Polynomial-space 63.852; cached
  37.930/33.623; exact O(NQ^2) labeling replacement measured 1.50-9.56x;
  precision peeling measured up to 14.34x.
- subsat_contraction_tree_2026-10-26.zip (f42479bca2):
  subsat_contraction_tree/, 37 files. Cached time pi sqrt(24339)/(20 ln2) =
  35.355, the smallest time coefficient, with space 34.275 and an imported
  fast-matrix backend; prefix-reuse kernel 101.95x.
- subexponential_sat_kernel_improvements_2026-10-26.zip (f42479bca2):
  subexponential_sat_kernel_improvements/, 58 files. Compositions 66.605
  (polynomial space) and 44.538/39.496. Adaptive Smith separator, Gray and
  antipodal streamed extraction, projective filter, measured 2.16-7.86x.

Nothing is omitted. Bundled baseline modules (reference_balanced_packing.py,
baseline_packet_extraction.py, the joint_cauchy.py copies) are byte copies
of placed files, but sibling modules import or load them, so they are kept.
Each archive was extracted with `py -I` into its own empty scratch directory
and checked for unsafe paths. Every member matched its packet's manifest,
and every filed file is byte-identical to its member. Five CRLF CSV files
are marked -text, and results/report_build.log is force-added past *.log.

Correction: the round-2 placement (6d3adc4506) omitted
3sat_round2_refinement/scripts/build_report.sh and
negative_integrity_controls.py as duplicates, although that packet's
replay_archive.py and README run them. Both are restored from 3e57705cf1 and
their two OMITTED.tsv rows removed. Duplicated .py/.sh files are now always
kept, and the round-2 counts in the README are corrected to match.

The project README gains a round-3 table, separate polynomial-space and
subexponential-space coefficient ladders (polynomial space: 18,535.75 ->
... -> 55.709, about 333x on the upper bound), low-degree figures and a
measured-speedups list. The docs/incoming table and the Computability index
are updated. Not included: eth_adaptive_schedules_2026-10-26.zip, which the
drop process staged but had not committed during this placement.

Place eight round-2 sub-exponential 3-SAT packets in SubexponentialSAT

File the second round of ETH refinement packets under
Computability/SubexponentialSAT/Research and retire their archives from
docs/incoming. All eight bound the OpenAI preprint's normalized tensor
contraction by 2^{(C+o(1)) s/sqrt(log2 s)}, with C per normalized wire.
None changes the SAT order n log log n/sqrt(log n), and none closes a
missing interface of the round-1 conditional proposals.

Retired archives, where each went, and the coefficient each claims:
- eth_asymmetric_packet_balancing_2026-10-26.zip (3e57705cf1):
  eth_asymmetric_packet_balancing/, 28 files. C = pi sqrt(5/2)(9+sqrt3)/ln2
  = 76.909, the smallest claimed; 31.064 at degree <= s^(1/12).
- 3sat_round2_refinement_20261027.zip (3e57705cf1): 3sat_round2_refinement/,
  46 files. C = 84.066 on s/sqrt(ceil(log2 s)), with an independent review
  and an audit of eth.pdf. 17 evidence/ copies of files already in ProveIt
  (OpenAI sources, eth.pdf, six placed report sources, our README,
  OMITTED.tsv, PROVENANCE.md, two scripts) are omitted.
- eth_balanced_packing_2026-10-26.zip (3e57705cf1): eth_balanced_packing/,
  22 files. C = 94.748.
- eth_high_moment_2026-10-26.zip (3e57705cf1): eth_high_moment/, 21 files.
  C = (9 pi/(4 ln2)) sqrt(15 log2 54) = 94.748, the same value.
- ETH_Matching_Packing_Thin_Gaps_2026-10-27.zip (d098ba436b):
  eth_matching_refinement/, 24 files. C = 94.748 again, a third independent
  derivation. 11 sources/ snapshots are omitted.
- eth_packet_refinement_2026-10-26.zip (3e57705cf1): eth_packet_refinement/,
  20 files. C = 9 pi sqrt22/(2 ln2) = 95.664.
- eth_recursive_refinement_2026-10-26.zip (3e57705cf1):
  eth_recursive_refinement/, 24 files. C = 133.207, with a mod-8 Cauchy
  slope of 64/21.
- eth_joint_cauchy_2026-10-26.zip (3e57705cf1): eth_joint_cauchy/, 26 files.
  C = 319.686 in polynomial space; a Strassen variant gets 225.597 time but
  needs subexponential space.

Each archive was extracted with `py -I` into its own empty scratch directory
and checked for unsafe member paths. Every member matched its packet's
checksum manifest. Every filed file is byte-identical to its member.
41 members are not filed:
- three SHA256SUMS ledgers (.gitignore policy);
- 38 byte-identical copies of files at ProveIt ab2fbc9e03/d098ba436b or
  openai/math@7ef5c0cc5c, appended to Research/OMITTED.tsv with the commit
  each matches. Every row was rechecked against the arrival ZIP and the named
  commit.

The OMITTED.tsv identity column is now `byte_identical_to`, prefixed with
its source. Three delivered CRLF CSV files are marked -text, and four
delivered qa/*.log audit logs are force-added past the *.log ignore rule.
No supplied script, test, Makefile or LaTeX build was run.

The project README gains a round-2 table and an updated coefficient ladder:
18,535.75 -> 648.44 -> 374.38 -> ... -> 76.909, about 241x on the upper
bound. The placement record, docs/incoming table and Computability index
are updated to match.

Summarize the strongest claimed improvements in SubexponentialSAT README

Add a section to Computability/SubexponentialSAT/README.md that ranks what
the seven packets claim against the OpenAI preprint's Appendix D bounds
(n log log n/sqrt(log n) in the worst case, n/sqrt(log n) at fixed density):

- Strongest proved claim: an improvement in one density regime only. It is
  claimed independently by sat_density_improvement and
  eth_density_refinement. At m = Theta(n log log n) the exponent goes from
  n log log n/sqrt(log n) to n log log log n/sqrt(log n). The worst-case and
  fixed-density exponents are unchanged.
- Proved improvements of constants only: about 28.6x (648.44 vs 18,535.75),
  a factor of 16, precision 24MD/u -> 6MD/u, and the 1/sqrt(3) mode ratio.
  Each is a comparison of upper bounds, not of runtimes.
- Strongest claim overall, conditional: 3sat_precision_refinement's
  n log log n/log n (n/log n at fixed density). It rests on an unproved
  summation algorithm. The weaker conditional proposals of 3sat_refinement
  and 3sat_asymptotic_analysis are listed with their missing steps.
- eth.pdf matches Appendix D's order in n and is not a refinement.

The summary is drawn from the packets' README and status files; nothing
was rechecked.

Vendor openai/math preprint "The Exponential Time Hypothesis is False"

Add an unmodified copy of the upstream manuscript directory
preprints/The-Exponential-Time-Hypothesis-is-False-October-25-2026 from
https://github.com/openai/math at commit
7ef5c0cc5ca4b0e072b7a050fca09ab24bc6fa3a, the head of main (committed
2026-10-26T21:18:03Z), fetched 2026-10-26. It goes under
lib/openai-math/preprints/, beside the existing Lean port, because lib/ is
the repository's only vendored-code root. It is the primary source of
Computability/SubexponentialSAT.

- Six files (README.md, paper.pdf, build/main_full_version.tex,
  build/quantitative-{reduction,contraction,circuits}.tex). They were taken
  from a shallow, blobless, sparse clone with `git cat-file blob`. Each
  staged blob ID equals the upstream tree entry, so the copy is byte for
  byte. The four build/*.tex files are force-added because the root
  .gitignore ignores build/ directories.
- License: upstream licenses the repository under Apache-2.0 and has no
  license file under preprints/. preprints/LICENSE is the unchanged upstream
  root LICENSE (blob 261eeb9e9f), byte-identical to the existing
  lib/openai-math/LICENSE. No copyright or NOTICE text is invented.
- preprints/PROVENANCE.md records the upstream URL, pinned commit, fetch
  method and date, and the per-file sizes and blobs. It notes that the
  directory is identical at the 42907c9e99 pin used by two packets, and that
  the upstream Lean development is not vendored.
- Links: lib/README.md, lib/openai-math/README.md and the
  Computability/SubexponentialSAT README point to the vendored copy. The
  project README now gives the 67-page paper.pdf a local link.

Nothing is built or compiled; the preprint is not part of the OAI library.

Place sub-exponential 3-SAT (ETH) reports in new Computability/SubexponentialSAT

Create the topic project Computability/SubexponentialSAT for claims that
#k-SAT runs in 2^{o(n)} time, refuting the Exponential Time Hypothesis, and
for reports that analyse those algorithms. Place all nine 3-SAT/ETH arrivals
of 26 October 2026 and retire them from docs/incoming.

New README.md: what the project is, its trust status (nothing checked in
ProveIt; no Lean/ or Coq/ yet), the two primary manuscripts, the upstream
openai/math Lean scope (lean/docs/378.md states a weaker
(log log n)^2/sqrt(log n) bound than the manuscript), and an index of the
seven packets with their claims and stated limits. Five packets pin
openai/math@7ef5c0cc5c and two pin 42907c9e99; the preprint directory is
blob-for-blob identical at both.

Retired archives and how each is accounted for:
- cauchy_mode_improvement_2026-10-26.zip (arrival a505bd768b):
  Research/cauchy_mode_improvement/, 17 files. Factorial Cauchy modes,
  1/sqrt(3) mode-count ratio; order unchanged.
- eth_contraction_improvements.zip (a505bd768b):
  Research/eth_contraction_improvements/, 15 files. Exact Hermite taper,
  schedule coefficient 648.44 vs 18,535.75, streamed packet extraction.
- sat_density_improvement.zip (a505bd768b):
  Research/sat_density_improvement/, 9 files. Density-aware bound
  2^{O_k((n/sqrt(log n)) min{log(2+m/n), log log n})}.
- eth.pdf (a505bd768b): Research/claude-2o-n-3sat/eth.pdf, the 49-page
  "A 2^{o(n)} time algorithm for 3-SAT" credited to Claude, whose Lean
  development is unpublished.
- paper.pdf (a505bd768b): not filed. It is byte-identical to the OpenAI
  preprint's paper.pdf (blob 0503566e95), recorded in Research/OMITTED.tsv.
- 3sat_precision_refinement_2026-10-26.zip (64b3202ee8):
  Research/3sat_precision_refinement/, 16 files. Precision 24MD/u -> 6MD/u;
  the stronger rates are conditional.
- 3sat_refinement_package.zip (64b3202ee8): Research/3sat_refinement/,
  12 files. Scalar parity lift k(n+a); the (log log n)^{3/2}/log n rate
  needs an unsupplied factorization.
- eth_density_refinement.zip (64b3202ee8):
  Research/eth_density_refinement/, 15 files. A density bound
  n log(2+B)/sqrt(log n), overlapping sat_density_improvement.
- 3sat_asymptotic_analysis_20261027.zip (8afdbbea48):
  Research/3sat_asymptotic_analysis/, 35 files. Barriers and two missing
  interfaces; no stronger bound. Its eight source/ copies of upstream files
  are omitted as byte-identical and listed with their blobs in OMITTED.tsv.

Each archive was extracted with `py -I` into its own empty scratch
directory. Every filed file matched the packet's own checksum manifest. Five
delivered SHA256SUMS ledgers are not committed: the root .gitignore excludes
them by policy (c00d8c3993). Two delivered CRLF CSV files are marked -text
in .gitattributes, so their staged blobs equal the delivered bytes. No
supplied script, test, Makefile or LaTeX build was run.

The docs/incoming README gains a table for this batch. The Computability and
root READMEs gain one-line entries for the new project.
